text:
mike_am: Riverview wants to swap a POC off NimbleAI onto Redwood next week. Short checklist from their infra lead: firm pricing for ~10M tokens/mo, exact header-preserve for legacy HMAC auth, length-prefixed streaming compatibility, deterministic JSON key ordering (downstream parser brittle), stop-token trimming semantics, completed security questionnaire, and per-request token logs for audit. Can we run a preflight and surface blockers?

sylvia_se: I got pricing + stream. Pricing: mid-tier fits; propose a one-month promotional credit (30%). Streaming: NimbleAI uses 2-byte length-prefixed frames with big-endian lengths. Our SSE stream can be wrapped by an adapter (frame_mode=nimble_compat) to emit those frames. Need to measure per-chunk overhead; rough estimate 8-20ms.

ojas_eng: Header passthrough: we currently drop cookies and a few sensitive headers. We can support preserve_headers at route-level. Need exact header list from Riverview (they mentioned X-RV-User and X-RV-Sign). If Authorization must be forwarded across tenants, legal wants to review.

petra_cs: Reached out to Riverview for sample requests/responses, their filled questionnaire, and their exact header list. They asked for our answers by Friday EOD. I uploaded a link to their uploads in presales drive and asked them to redact secrets: https://redwood.app/drive/riverview/presales

felix_sec: Security summary: Data residency doable via Dedicated in us-east-1 or Private. Customer-managed KMS supported only on Private. We do support per-request token logs under NDA, but retention/PII guidance required. I'll start the questionnaire draft and flag CISO/legal items.

sylvia_se: On JSON parity + stop tokens: NimbleAI strips the stop token and collapses consecutive newlines; they also canonicalize keys alphabetically which their parser expects. Options: (1) server-side compat flags: stop_strip=true and canonicalize_json_keys=alpha, (2) client side shim. For speed of POC I recommend (1) route-level compat. Ojas, is that reasonable?

ojas_eng: Yep, can add compat flags. Proto: route params { frame_mode: "nimble_compat", stop_strip: true, canonicalize_json: "alpha" }. Will add a small translator middleware and test in staging. Quick nginx-like snippet for header allowlist: 

# ingress translator
proxy_set_header X-Preserve "x-rv-user,x-rv-sign,x-trace-id";

I'll run e2e smoke once branch is ready.

mike_am: Nice. Billing nuance: Riverview said their current provider bills in 3-token buckets and requires an auditor-ready invoice with per-route line items. Can finance generate a sample invoice and explain rounding?

felix_sec: We can produce per-route aggregated counts for invoices and, under NDA, per-request token logs with tokenizer samples. If they want us to persist raw request bodies we need CISO approval. I'll note that for legal.

petra_cs: Riverview uploaded their questionnaire and sample payloads (redacted). They accept a 30% promo. They also want to be sure function-calls (structured tool calls) survive translation.

ojas_eng: Good call on function-calls: we preserve the function-call envelope, but canonicalize_json could reorder keys. I'll ensure canonicalize_json keeps nested function-call objects intact (no key reordering inside function args) — will add an option canonicalize_json_scope=["top_level"].

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging rwd-presales-9 is available for smoke runs; namespace "riverview-poc". Ephemeral creds expire in 48h. Recommended tests: 1) length-prefixed stream smoke (20 prompts), 2) stop_strip + canonicalize_json smoke (30 prompts), 3) header passthrough check. Logs will be captured to /var/presales/riverview for 48h. :rocket:

sylvia_se: I'll prototype the frame adapter and measure latency. ETA: branch by tomorrow morning. Ojas, please add the compat flags PR and run the staging smoke. Felix, please draft the questionnaire answers so Petra can send them by Friday.

petra_cs: Copy. Action items: Sylvia - frame adapter + latency numbers. Ojas - compat flags PR + e2e smoke. Felix - questionnaire draft + KMS guidance. Finance/legal - sample invoice + NDA for per-request logs. I'll assemble the POC SOW after smoke logs. Need everything by Friday noon.

mike_am: Thanks all. Will hold off on sending the SOW until we get green smoke and the sample invoice. :thumbsup:
